# Hearthside Visits

Hearthside Visits brings library books, large print, and audiobooks to patrons who cannot get to a branch because of illness, disability, or age. Trained volunteers visit each patron once a month with a bag chosen for that reader and pick up the previous month's items.

## Who can join

Any cardholder in the five-branch area who cannot leave home for a short trip, for three months or more. Residents of the two partner senior housing buildings join through their activity directors.

## How it runs

About 30 volunteers cover 85 patrons. Each volunteer has two to four regular visits. Items are checked out to the patron on a long loan.

## Owner

[[Wendeline Okafor]] coordinates volunteers and patrons. The visit schedule follows the [[Decision - Monthly visit rotation]].
